title: Bread Making
summary: Bread making involved grinding grain, kneading dough, leavening or unleavening, baking, and sharing meals.
background: Bread was a staple of daily life and could symbolize provision, fellowship, worship, teaching, and Christ Himself.
teachingHelp: When teaching bread texts, ask whether the passage emphasizes need, fellowship, covenant, purity, or Christ as the bread of life.
